analysis_type: post hoc descriptive analysis; no new rollouts, parameter changes, GPU calls, or intervention

definitions.action_source: telemetry actions actually passed to env.step, exactly checked against each infer executed_length prefix in arrays.npz
definitions.switch: Adjacent actually executed commands have different np.sign(gripper); signs include neutral zero. No neutral zero occurred if aggregate neutral_commands is zero.
definitions.zero_switch: No gripper sign changes within the episode, including the Gaussian bootstrap commands.
definitions.all_negative: Every actually executed gripper command is strictly negative: open-command throughout, not a measurement of physical finger joint position.
definitions.sixdim_saturation: Fraction of executed pre-controller six-dimensional command components with abs(value)>=0.999; descriptive only.

limitations: This analysis was specified after observing early outcomes; it is not a preregistered mechanism test.
Each condition follows its own closed-loop trajectory. Sign switching and success are correlated outcomes, not a controlled mediator intervention.
Tau jointly changes the six-dimensional motion prior weight, all-dimensional noise amplitude, time embedding, and one-step integration interval.

The six-dimensional Kalman filter does not predict gripper changes, but the full seven-command initial prior carries the last acknowledged gripper value; this was already verified in the earlier read-only mechanism audit.
No isolated change to gripper initialization/update was tested, so the data cannot identify gripper sticking as the sole cause of failure.
Gripper signs describe commands, not independently measured finger positions. Some tasks can succeed without switching the gripper.
The 40 cases per condition are exploratory; Gaussian D1/D2 and tau0.75 are read-only historical references, not fresh same-card timing controls.
